title: Logspace uniformity and adjacency characterization
statement: Let $C$ be a family of Boolean circuits, and suppose every circuit in the family is canonical: the arguments of each gate are strictly increasing, and the output vertex is the last vertex. Then $C$ is logspace-uniform if and only if it has polynomial size and its size language, every gate-type language, and edge language are decidable in logarithmic space.
hypotheses_covered: Every circuit in $C$ is canonical: each gate's argument list is strictly increasing
